q: Saudi Arabia beat Argentina 2-1 at the 2022 World Cup. What did King Salman give the country the next day?
a: A public holiday, for workers and students alike
note: Al Jazeera: King Salman declared a public holiday for public and private workers and students the next day.

q: Edgar Davids was sent home from Euro 96. What had he said Guus Hiddink should stop doing?
a: Putting his head up some players' backsides
sub: Hiddink still picked him again for the 1998 World Cup.
note: Wikipedia Davids: sent home from Euro 96 for the remark about Hiddink, played at the 1998 World Cup.
